name: Kenzo
source:
A mysterious amnesiac boy who was protected by Arty Rain during the events of this work. The name "Kenzo" is not his real name, but a gift from Kotetsu. 

He is very mischievous and full of energy... He is also very perverted and is always eager to "snuggle" with attractive magical girls, which seems to be his favorite pastime. However, he is surprisingly honest and devotedly supports Kotetsu and her friends with his strengthening magic, even when they are struggling. He is highly regarded by all the magical girls. What is his true identity...?

[Translated from the [url=https://i.imgur.com/FzAHjDI.jpeg]official character description[/url]]
